stories.title: Small cups, big goal: Salt Lake City students join worldwide record attempt
stories.summary: Students at Ensign Elementary are helping chase a world record through sport stacking, an activity their PE teacher says builds coordination, concentration and confidence.

stories.title: Lake Powell dropped 165 feet. What emerged stunned scientists
stories.summary: Since Lake Powell dropped, ecosystems buried for decades are regrowing — but nothing is protecting them.

stories.title: Man killed in Salt Lake City shooting after disagreement Wednesday
stories.summary: One man was killed in a shooting Wednesday night, police said.

stories.title: Social media firms not liable for the 2022 Buffalo mass shooting, New York's top court says
stories.summary: Facebook, YouTube and other social media giants aren't liable for the racist mass shooting at a supermarket in Buffalo, New York, the state's highest court ruled this week.

stories.title: Have You Seen This? Turkeys take their revenge
stories.summary: Are you eating turkey today? Don't let these feathered fiends find out.

stories.title: At least 31 killed in fuel tanker fire near Cairo, Egyptian authorities say
stories.summary: A tanker truck carrying petroleum products crashed in Egypt's Giza governorate Wednesday, igniting a massive fire that killed at least 31 people and injured 21 others, according to Egyptian authorities.

stories.title: As plans for a Carbon County data center and nuclear reactors advance, residents push to be heard
stories.summary: A group of neighbors frustrated with a company's plan to bring hundreds of small nuclear reactors and a data center to Carbon County made a long-shot pitch Thursday.

stories.title: 22 states are suing the feds for ending immigrant housing aid
stories.summary: Twenty-two attorneys general across the nation have banded together against a new federal rule that would eliminate federal housing assistance for families living with ineligible noncitizens — claiming it violates federal law.

stories.title: US authorizes SpaceX to deploy 1 million satellites for AI data centers in space
stories.summary: The Federal Communications Commission has authorized Elon Musk's SpaceX to deploy 1 million satellites in space for the creation of data centers critical to powering artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Santa Claus getting new 'mid-century' sleigh in time for Ogden's Holiday Electric Light Parade
stories.summary: Santa Claus is getting a new "mid-century" sleigh with a lot more lights and repainted reindeer in time for Ogden's Holiday Electric Light Parade.

stories.title: Full extent of Christa Pike injuries 'still unknown' 2 months after botched execution, attorney said
stories.summary: The full extent of Christa Pike's injuries is "still unknown" two months after her botched execution, her attorney said in a new legal filing in a Nashville, Tennessee, court.

stories.title: Supreme Court to hear case over prayer gatherings in a private home
stories.summary: SCOTUS will hear a man's challenge to a city permit demand, after claims that officials' warnings stopped him from hosting an Orthodox Jewish prayer gathering in his home.
